headline: CIN @ NYY matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CIN 4.59 at NYY 4.34, with a projected total of 8.93. Batter research is strongest for Paul Goldschmidt, Blake Dunn, Noelvi Marte, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Spencer Steer, Max Schuemann because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
